race:draka.title: Draka
race:draka.summary: Scaled, winged and warm-blooded in every sense. The draka hatch from eggs in the volcano peaks of Kaldera, carry a fire inside them, and believe they are the last children of the dragons.

sections.title: Who they are
sections.text: Draka are tall and scaled, with small wings that let them glide and a fire in their chest that lets them breathe sparks, or more. They live about two hundred years. They hatch in clutches, are raised by their flight, and feel the cold the way other peoples feel grief. They are proud, passionate and fiercely loyal, and they hoard. Everyone hoards something.

sections.title: Where they live
sections.text: In the volcano peaks of [[place:kaldera|Kaldera]], around the great forge called the Heartforge. The [[culture:draka.ashwing|Ashwing]] ride the updrafts, the [[culture:draka.cinderscale|Cinderscale]] guard the forge, and the [[culture:draka.emberkin|Emberkin]] speak to the flames and mend with warmth.

sections.title: The ember-songs
sections.text: Draka sing their history to their eggs. The [[faith:ember-songs|ember-songs]] tell of the dragons who made the world, of the [[era:sundering|Sundering]], and of Aurvanth the Last, who sleeps under their mountain. Every draka is sure they are her children's children. Every draka is also sure they will be the one to hear her wake.

sections.title: Among the Pact
sections.text: The draka were not among the [[era:first-five|First Five]]. In 790 AS the [[faction:fire-council|Fire Council]] sent a flame-speaker to ask to join the [[faction:pact|Pact]], and a sixth chair was added to the table at the Five Flagons. Since the [[era:waking|Waking]] began and the Heartforge started cooling, draka have been coming down from the peaks in numbers nobody has seen before.

facts: Ember Heart: half damage from fire, Recovery counts 10% higher
quote: Every fire is a song. Ours is just louder.

heritage:draka.title: Draka Heritage
heritage:draka.summary: Draka heritage is sung: verses of the ember-songs, sung to every egg before it hatches. Renown is earning a verse of your own, and flight-kin who sing beside you make the verse come sooner.

sections.title: A verse of your own
sections.text: Every draka dreams of being sung to eggs one day. A deed worth a verse must be witnessed by the flight, and draka who fight together are each other's witnesses. The flame-speakers say a draka with a verse never quite goes cold, even after death.

heritage:draka.trunk0.title: Scales
heritage:draka.trunk0.summary: Draka scales harden with age and heat, and turn aside blows that would cut anyone else.

heritage:draka.trunk1.title: Inner Fire
heritage:draka.trunk1.summary: The fire in every draka's chest, which heals them, warms them and, when needed, burns.

heritage:draka.trunk2.title: Sagas
heritage:draka.trunk2.summary: The verses of the ember-songs, sung to every egg. Each deed worth a verse brings more Renown.

heritage:draka.ashwing0.title: Updraft Wings
heritage:draka.ashwing0.summary: Ashwing draka ride the hot air of the peaks, and their wings make them hard to pin down.

heritage:draka.ashwing1.title: Talons
heritage:draka.ashwing1.summary: The talons of the sky riders, who strike from above and are gone before the blow is felt.

heritage:draka.ashwing2.title: Ashwing Kinship
heritage:draka.ashwing2.summary: An Ashwing flight flies, hunts and roosts as one. Two in a band fight like a flight.

heritage:draka.cinderscale0.title: Forge Scales
heritage:draka.cinderscale0.summary: Scales tempered beside the Heartforge for generations, as hard as anything forged in it.

heritage:draka.cinderscale1.title: Smoke Roar
heritage:draka.cinderscale1.summary: The roar of the forge guards, which shakes the forge and draws every enemy's eye.

heritage:draka.cinderscale2.title: Cinderscale Kinship
heritage:draka.cinderscale2.summary: The forge families stand together as they have for a thousand years. Two in a band are a wall of scale.

heritage:draka.emberkin0.title: Kindle
heritage:draka.emberkin0.summary: The Emberkin gift of lighting the fire in others, which mends wounds as well as warming hearts.

heritage:draka.emberkin1.title: Hearth Glow
heritage:draka.emberkin1.summary: The steady warmth of an Emberkin, which keeps everyone near them going.

heritage:draka.emberkin2.title: Emberkin Kinship
heritage:draka.emberkin2.summary: Emberkin share their fire. With two in a band, nobody goes cold.

culture:draka.ashwing.title: Ashwing
culture:draka.ashwing.kicker: Sky riders of the volcano peaks
culture:draka.ashwing.summary: The draka of the high cliffs, who ride the volcanic updrafts, dive for the thrill of it, and live as flights that fly, hunt and roost as one.

sections.title: The cliffs
sections.text: The outer peaks of [[place:kaldera|Kaldera]] are sheer and full of hot air rising from the vents. The Ashwing nest there, in caves on the cliff faces, and learn to ride the updrafts before they can walk properly.

sections.title: The people
sections.text: Ashwing draka are sky riders, hunters and daredevils. They value speed, nerve and their flight above everything. They hunt mountain goats from the air, race each other through storms, and consider any draka who has never dived off a peak to be a little sad.

sections.title: The Great Updraft
sections.text: Once a year a column of hot air rises from the crater higher than the clouds. Riding it to the top of the sky is the greatest deed an Ashwing can do, and the ember-songs remember every one who has.

quote: The ground is just where you stop.

culture:draka.cinderscale.title: Cinderscale
culture:draka.cinderscale.summary: The forge families of the draka, who have guarded and tended the Heartforge since it was lit, and who are the most worried people in Valdren right now.

sections.title: The Heartforge
sections.text: At the centre of [[place:kaldera|Kaldera]] burns the Heartforge, a crack straight down to the [[world:underflame|Underflame]] that the dragons left open so their children would stay warm. The Cinderscale have guarded it for a thousand years, worked its bellows and forged its fire into the finest metal in the world.

sections.title: The people
sections.text: Cinderscale draka are forge guards, smiths and bellows keepers. They are big, steady and loud, with scales tempered dark by generations beside the forge. They value duty and endurance, and they do not leave their post.

sections.title: The cooling
sections.text: Since the [[era:waking|Waking]] began, the Heartforge burns lower every winter. The Cinderscale have tried everything they know. Some have gone down from the mountain to find out why, which no Cinderscale has done in living memory.

facts: A low rumble in the chest
quote: The forge does not go out on our watch.

culture:draka.emberkin.title: Emberkin
culture:draka.emberkin.summary: The draka who speak to fire: healers who mend with warmth, kindlers who light the season's fires, and flame-speakers who speak for their clans at the Fire Council.

sections.title: The fires
sections.text: Every draka nest has a hearth, and every hearth has an Emberkin. They light the first fire of each season, keep the hearths burning, and listen to what the flames say.

sections.title: The people
sections.text: Emberkin draka are healers, kindlers and flame-speakers. They are gentle by draka standards, which means they only shout when necessary. Their healers mend burns with warmth instead of water, and their flame-speakers speak for the clans at the [[faction:fire-council|Fire Council]].

sections.title: The sixth chair
sections.text: It was an Emberkin flame-speaker who came down from the mountain in 790 AS to ask the [[faction:pact|Pact]] for a place at its table. Her name, Ysra Brightcoal, is sung to every Emberkin egg.

quote: Warmth heals what water only cools.

backstory:draka.skyrider.title: Sky Rider
backstory:draka.skyrider.summary: Rode the updrafts above the volcano before they could walk, and has never been happy on the ground.

sections.title: Riders
sections.text: Ashwing hatchlings are carried into the updrafts by their parents and let go. Most learn to glide in the first fall.

backstory:draka.diver.title: Cliff Diver
backstory:draka.diver.summary: Dove from the peaks of Kaldera for the thrill of the fall, pulling up later every time.

sections.title: Divers
sections.text: Cliff diving is the Ashwing sport. The diver who pulls up last, and lives, wins. The [[faith:ember-songs|ember-songs]] have a verse for the ones who did not.

backstory:draka.flight.title: Flight-born
backstory:draka.flight.summary: Hatched into an Ashwing flight that flies, hunts and roosts as one, and has never been alone since.

sections.title: Flights
sections.text: An Ashwing flight is a family of the air: a dozen draka who hunt together and sleep in one cave. A flight-born draka feels every one of them, even far away.

backstory:draka.forgeguard.title: Forge Guard
backstory:draka.forgeguard.summary: Stood watch at the Heartforge where the lava runs, and does not like leaving a post.

sections.title: The watch
sections.text: The forge guards of the [[culture:draka.cinderscale|Cinderscale]] stand watch in shifts that have not been broken in a thousand years.

backstory:draka.bellows.title: Bellows Keeper
backstory:draka.bellows.summary: Worked the great bellows of the Heartforge until their roar shook the forge.

sections.title: The bellows
sections.text: The Heartforge's bellows are the size of a house, and are worked by draka who sing to keep the rhythm. Bellows keepers are the loudest draka in Kaldera.

backstory:draka.forgekin.title: Forge-kin
backstory:draka.forgekin.summary: One of the families who have tended the Heartforge since it was lit, a thousand years of duty in their scales.

sections.title: Forge families
sections.text: Nine Cinderscale families have tended the Heartforge since the dragons lit it. Their scales are darker than any others, tempered by the forge for forty generations.

backstory:draka.kindler.title: Kindler
backstory:draka.kindler.summary: Lit the first fires of every season in the nests of Kaldera.

sections.title: Kindlers
sections.text: The Emberkin kindler lights each season's first fire from the Heartforge itself, and carries it from nest to nest. It is the most honoured task a young Emberkin can be given.

backstory:draka.mender.title: Ember Mender
backstory:draka.mender.summary: Healed burns with warmth instead of water, the Emberkin way.

sections.title: Menders
sections.text: Emberkin menders draw the hurt out of a burn with gentle fire. Other peoples find it terrifying, until it works.

backstory:draka.flamespeaker.title: Flame-speaker
backstory:draka.flamespeaker.summary: Spoke for their clan at the great fire councils, and has a voice that carries.

sections.title: The councils
sections.text: Flame-speakers speak into the fire at the [[faction:fire-council|Fire Council]], and the fire answers. A young flame-speaker chosen by their clan is trusted with its whole voice.

answer:draka.grandparents.0.summary: The ember-songs tell of draka who spoke with Aurvanth before she slept. Nobody has spoken with a dragon since.

answer:draka.grandparents.1.summary: Volcano-divers go down into the crater's heart, closer to the Underflame than anyone else alive. Few come back the same.

answer:draka.grandparents.2.summary: The first stones of the Heartforge were laid by the forge families when the dragons left it open. Their names are the first verse of the forge-song.

answer:draka.grandparents.3.summary: Sky-wanderers fly beyond the clouds. The ember-songs say a few saw the curve of the world, and came back very quiet.

answer:draka.parents.0.summary: Forge-tenders sleep beside the Heartforge on cold nights. Lately, the nights beside it are colder.

answer:draka.parents.1.summary: Flame-speakers speak for their clan at the Fire Council, which has been meeting about the forge for two years.

answer:draka.parents.2.summary: Egg-wardens guard the clutch chambers, the most honoured duty of the draka, and the most dangerous since the egg-thieves came.

answer:draka.parents.3.summary: Sky-hunters of the Ashwing bring down mountain goats from the air, and feed whole nests in winter.

answer:draka.siblings.0.summary: Draka clutches are large, and the last out of the shell is said to be the luckiest.

answer:draka.siblings.1.summary: The first to hatch is supposed to watch over the rest. They mostly remind them who hatched first.

answer:draka.siblings.2.summary: An egg that has gone cold rarely hatches. One that does is said to have its own fire, and a stubborn one.

answer:draka.siblings.3.summary: Twin hatchlings from one egg are rare and are sung as one verse in the ember-songs.

answer:draka.birth.0.summary: Eruptions at Kaldera are feared and celebrated. Eggs found in warm ash afterward are said to be blessed by the Mother.

answer:draka.birth.1.summary: Roars from inside the mountain have been heard more often since the Waking. No living draka can make that sound.

answer:draka.birth.2.summary: Snow at Kaldera is rare and frightening. A hatchling born in it is said to carry a fire that refuses to go out.

answer:draka.birth.3.summary: Old sky-riders bring news from far away. The news brought on the day of a hatching is always sung, even when nobody remembers it.

answer:draka.friend.0.summary: Fire-salamanders live in every draka hearth and are considered good luck, and good company.

answer:draka.friend.1.summary: Clutch-siblings dare each other into everything. Half the verses in the ember-songs begin with a dare.

answer:draka.friend.2.summary: Mountain hawks ride the same updrafts as the Ashwing, and many young draka learn to fly by following one.

answer:draka.friend.3.summary: Old forge-keepers talk to the Heartforge's flames. The flames, they say, talk back.

answer:draka.play.0.summary: Every draka hatchling breathes sparks before they can talk, and every draka nest has scorched curtains.

answer:draka.play.1.summary: Gliding off cliffs before the wings are ready is how Ashwing hatchlings learn, and why Ashwing healers are so busy.

answer:draka.play.2.summary: Sitting in the Heartforge's warmth is the favourite pastime of every Cinderscale hatchling.

answer:draka.play.3.summary: Every draka hoards something. Hatchling hoards are small, strange and fiercely guarded.

answer:draka.teen.0.summary: A first true flight during the molting years is a rite of passage. Into a storm is a very good story.

answer:draka.teen.1.summary: Apprentices of the Heartforge learn to work metal in the hottest fire in the world.

answer:draka.teen.2.summary: Ember-mending is the Emberkin art of healing with gentle flame, and takes a lifetime to master.

answer:draka.teen.3.summary: The molting years are when a draka's inner fire burns hottest and their temper shortest.

answer:draka.firstfight.0.summary: Wyverns raid the goat pens of Kaldera. The draka consider them an insult to the dragons.

answer:draka.firstfight.1.summary: Egg-thieves come for draka eggs, which sell for fortunes in the cities. The egg-wardens are not merciful.

answer:draka.firstfight.2.summary: Aerial duels between rivals are an Ashwing tradition, and usually end with a dive.

answer:draka.firstfight.3.summary: A draka whose fire runs wild burns friend and foe alike. The Emberkin teach control for exactly this reason.

answer:draka.mentor.0.summary: Sky-riders who lose a wing and fly anyway are the most respected teachers of the Ashwing.

answer:draka.mentor.1.summary: The forge-master of the Heartforge is chosen once a century, and is said to understand fire better than anyone alive.

answer:draka.mentor.2.summary: Old flame-speakers heal with warmth and teach that fire is for mending first and burning last.

answer:draka.mentor.3.summary: Human scholars who study dragons come to Kaldera with questions. The draka find them brave and exhausting.

answer:draka.leaving.0.summary: The ember-songs say Aurvanth sleeps under Kaldera, but some draka think other dragons sleep elsewhere, waiting to be found.

answer:draka.leaving.1.summary: Burning the egg-warden's hall is one of the few crimes for which draka are sent from the mountain.

answer:draka.leaving.2.summary: The Heartforge is cooling, and nobody on the mountain knows why. Someone has to go and find out.

answer:draka.leaving.3.summary: Draka grow until they do not fit in the nest anymore, and then they leave. Most come back. Some do not.

answer:draka.deed.0.summary: Relighting a dying forge with one's own breath is a deed the ember-songs place beside the dragons'.

answer:draka.deed.1.summary: Rescuing a clutch of eggs is the deed draka honour above all, because every egg is a future verse.

answer:draka.deed.2.summary: The Great Updraft rises once a year from Kaldera's crater, higher than the clouds.

answer:draka.deed.3.summary: Draka who heal human villages are few, and the villages never forget them.

answer:draka.loss.0.summary: Storms over the peaks have taken many Ashwing. Their wing-friends sing their verse every year.

answer:draka.loss.1.summary: A draka without a hoard feels naked, and one robbed of it does not stop looking. Ever.

answer:draka.loss.2.summary: The forge-master's trust is the hardest thing in Kaldera to win back.

answer:draka.loss.3.summary: Draka guard their luck like a hoard, and are sure it can be stolen like one.

answer:draka.fear.0.summary: A draka's inner fire going cold is death long before death. The cooling of the Heartforge makes this fear very real.

answer:draka.fear.1.summary: Draka who once lost control of their fire carry the fear forever. The Emberkin help them carry it.

answer:draka.fear.2.summary: A draka with broken wings can still live a long life. Most would rather not.

answer:draka.fear.3.summary: Deep cold water is the opposite of everything a draka is.

answer:draka.keepsake.0.summary: Draka keep a shard of their own egg, and are buried with it.

answer:draka.keepsake.1.summary: A coal from the Heartforge never quite goes out. Carrying one is carrying home.

answer:draka.keepsake.2.summary: Scales said to come from true dragons are the most precious things a draka family owns. Some might even be real.

answer:draka.keepsake.3.summary: Every draka keeps a hoard, and counts it every night, and knows instantly if one thing is missing.

answer:draka.drive.0.summary: Waking the dragons is the oldest dream in the ember-songs, and since the Waking, the most argued about.

answer:draka.drive.1.summary: A hoard big enough to sleep on is every draka's dream. The Hollows of the Pact are the surest road to one.

answer:draka.drive.2.summary: Keeping the Heartforge burning for the next clutch is the most important task any draka has ever been given.

answer:draka.drive.3.summary: The sky goes everywhere, and since the Waking, everywhere needs heroes.
